status: Review completed; two focused exposition recommendations and one optional display refinement. Manuscript unchanged.
audience: Mathematically trained human reader familiar with linear algebra, power series, complex analysis and basic linear differential systems, without prior study of Fischler's construction.
reading_scope: Complete current LaTeX manuscript: abstract, all seven sections and references. Three imported propositions treated as stated inputs. Particular attention to the origin of the square-root scale.

earlier_review_assessment.findings_H1_through_H7: Addressed in the current manuscript. The new recommendations are narrower local bridges, not a reopening of the previous structural recommendations.

findings.title: Show the differential cancellation in the h=1 example
findings.recommendation: Demonstrate the derivative relation for Z_j=L*g_j-j*g_(j+1), so the h=1 example shows differential closure as well as the common row. Replace the easy first-two-component check or shorten adjacent prose.

findings.title: Expose the coefficient correspondence in the Laplace-transform step
findings.recommendation: Display the Laplace integral of u^k/k! and identify A_(k+1)=G^(k)(0), then the order transfer through exp(-u). Keep the asymptotic or finite-partial-fraction justification explicit.

findings.title: Make the square-root balance easier to locate at a glance
findings.recommendation: Optionally replace part of the existing prose with a displayed scale balance Omega^2/a of order log a and the resulting dimension-bound scale. The current prose already explains the mechanism; no optimization claim is proposed.

verification_scope.suggested_illustration_check: Direct SymPy substitution confirmed the generic h=1 relation Z_j prime=-Z_(j-1)/z-Z_j/(2z) for j>=2; no permanent test or manuscript files were changed.
verification_scope.limitations: Editorial review by the developing assistant; not a new mathematical audit, independent model review or formal verification.

distribution: Local review records and README index only; no publication or external submission.
